newsitem.title: USA: National City Bancorp Q4 chargeoffs rise.
newsitem.headline: National City Bancorp Q4 chargeoffs rise.

text.p: National City Bancorp on Wednesday said its net loan chargeoffs rose to $965,000 in the fourth quarter from $158,000 in the same year-ago period.
For all of 1996, net loan chargeoffs rose to $2.4 million from $846,000 in 1995.

National City said non-performing assets were $2.3 million, or 0.3 percent of loans outstanding, as of December 31, compared with $3.7 million, or 0.7 percent of loans outstanding, at the end of 1995.
The bank holding company reported fourth-quarter earnings rose to $0.47 a share from $0.40 a share in the year-earlier period.
